E012 Automatisierungstechnik Grundlagen (process control, Leittechnik) and E171 SPS cover parts, but safety PLC, robot integration and renewable energy automation practicals are not covered; E012+E171 as E2 arguable

E149 Programmierung 1 (imperative/procedural programming) plus E087 Informatik 2 (introduction to C++ and object orientation) teach the same C++ beginner content

E132 Optoelektronische Systeme (optics, light sources and sensors) plus E136 practical training cover the optoelectronics content; semiconductor physics depth and the gender/diversity part would be added

E179 Theoretische Informatik teaches regular languages, grammars, parsers and parser generators (compiler front end); semantic analysis, code generation/optimisation and javacc practice are not covered
No EMI module teaches medical imaging physics (X-ray, CT, MRI, PET, ultrasound); timetable subject T174 Medical Systems Engineering is broader and its name does not state imaging

E122 Mechatronische Systeme (drives, sensors, signals, sampling) and E045 Elektrische Messtechnik (measurement chains, ADC) cover parts; transducer principles and sensor/actuator design are not taught as such; E122+E045 as E2 arguable
ML basics are in E112 Machine Learning 1 and security basics in E091, but AI for cyber security (AI4CY/CY4AI) is not; timetable subject T005 AI Security and Privacy names the topic

E091 Informationssicherheit covers threat models, attack vectors and security tools at introductory level; hands-on web attacks, pentesting, side channels, reverse engineering and forensics are not taught
Advanced state-space control (normal forms, state feedback, observers); E158 Regelungstechnik mentions state-space description but is an introductory classical control module

E041 Echtzeitbetriebssysteme (RTOS, scheduling algorithms, synchronisation) plus E053 Embedded Systems (microcontroller hardware and software) cover most; multicore scheduling and AUTOSAR/OSEK specifics would be added

Elective slot with variable content (ML, informatics, maths, geodata); EMI offers elective modules of that kind at bachelor level (E003/E004 Allgemeine Wahlpflichtmodule, also E105/E106 and geoinformatics modules)

E120 Mathematik fuer Ingenieure 2 (integration) plus E121 Mathematik fuer Ingenieure 3 (Taylor and Fourier series, multidimensional differentiation, extrema) cover most of Analysis 2; constrained extrema and implicit functions partly missing
E116 Mathematik 1 (sequences, continuity, differentiation, integration) plus E118 Mathematik 3 (series, power and Taylor series) cover the Analysis 1 topics, at a less proof-oriented level
